title: Query count under coordinate permutations
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $
Omega$ be a set of coordinate values, and let $
alpha$ be a set of leaf labels. A finite decision tree queries coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, branching according to the observed coordinate value; let $T$ be such a tree with all coordinates initially available, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the coordinates, and let $x$ assign a value in $\Omega$ to each coordinate. The number of queries made by the tree obtained by permuting the coordinates of $T$ is the number made by $T$ on the input whose value at coordinate $i$ is $x(\sigma(i))$.
